links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4 answers (FRE, FKGL, GFI, CLI, SMOG) about hypothyroidism in pregnancy
links.effect: Median FRE was 32.20 (13.00-37.10); required years of education were mostly university level, 9 (47.3%) of answers.
links.quote: The years of education required to read the answers were mostly found at the university level [9 (47.3%)].

screen.reason: Evaluates the reliability and readability of ChatGPT-4 responses to 19 clinical questions about hypothyroidism in pregnancy without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
